_comment: agent-relay managed hooks for Codex CLI. Edits between _agent_relay_managed markers are owned by `relay hooks install/uninstall`. The {RELAY_HOOK_PATH} token is replaced by the installer with the absolute path to relay-hook.py. Each entry is APPENDED to ~/.codex/hooks.json's hooks.<Event> array (preserving existing oh-my-codex etc. entries and their trust-key indices).
